references.text: The priests were to teach the Israelites all the laws of the Lord, which He had spoken to them through Moses
Incense was placed on the altar by the priests as part of the offering service
The burnt offering was to be burned completely on the altar, a holy offering to the Lord
Aaron was to burn fragrant incense on the incense altar every morning and evening
Only Aaron's descendants could burn incense before the face of the Lord
The priest's lips should guard knowledge, and they should seek instruction from his mouth, for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts
The priests were to teach the people the difference between holy and common, and to instruct them in distinguishing between unclean and clean
The priests were to burn part of the offering on the altar as a fire offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord
The Levites read from the Book of the Law and explained it to the people so they could understand what was being read
The high priest's duty was to present gifts and sin offerings on behalf of the people
